overview: A token app for TTTI-T where users buy with ICP, ckBTC, ckUSDC, ckUSDT or Bitcoin, manage a wallet and read the white paper.
features: Buy TTTI-T with ICP, ckBTC, ckUSDC, ckUSDT or Bitcoin
Built-in wallet with personal purchase history
Live transaction links to the explorer
Corrected white paper matching how the app works, next to the preserved original
